_about: Public-domain Robert Halley (1796-1876), Congregational minister in Manchester and Principal of New College, London, for the Word Hoard: The Sinfulness of Colonial Slavery (1833), The Sacraments, an Inquiry (vol. 2, 1844), a Reply to lectures on the Church, Lancashire: its Puritanism and Nonconformity (1869) and The Relation of the Church to the State. from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 59 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
